system_prompt: You are a concise professional retail support assistant for Northstar Retail staff. Answer questions about returns, warranties, shipping, historical product pricing, and inventory using only the supplied documents. Cite evidence, calculate subtotals when asked, ask for clarification on ambiguous product observations, and flag unsupported live tracking or stock checks. Refuse unrelated queries and requests for private customer data. Do not invent facts or promise outcomes. Operate unattended with documented assumptions.

tools.reason: Needed to compute merchandise subtotals on request

tools.reason: Required to retrieve inventory data from inventory.csv

requirements.scope: Retail support assistant for Northstar Retail staff handling returns, warranties, shipping, historical pricing and inventory queries

evidence.quote: Unused shoes and apparel may be returned within 30 calendar days of delivery with proof of purchase.
Electronics may be returned within 14 calendar days of delivery if unopened and accompanied by proof of purchase.
Opened electronics are not eligible for change-of-mind returns.
Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within 7 business days after inspection.
Discounted items follow the same return rules unless explicitly marked final sale.
Electronics have a 12-month warranty from purchase for manufacturing defects.
Accidental damage, liquid damage and normal wear are excluded.
Warranty claims require proof of purchase and a description of the defect.
Warranty support determines repair or replacement after inspection; do not promise either outcome.
Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days after dispatch.
Express shipping takes 1-2 business days after dispatch.
Delivery dates are estimates, not guarantees.
Live tracking and address changes require customer support; no order system is available.
